title: Toggling a column applies immediately across summary rows, detail rows and the grand Totals at once
custom_preconds: 1. A rep is expanded and the Totals indicator is visible.
custom_steps:
1. Toggle "Parts Margin" off and immediately check the summary rows, detail rows, and the Totals row.
2. Toggle it back on.
custom_expected:
1. The toggle takes effect immediately — no confirm step.
2. Hiding a metric column removes it from rep summary rows, invoice detail rows, and the grand Totals indicator simultaneously; showing restores it everywhere at once.
